title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

  
  
  
  

Location: Hyderabad

  
  

Experience:

  
  

BS and 5-8 years  
MS and 3-6 years  
PhD and 0-3 yea

  
  

Primary Areas: Agentic AI, LLM Application Development, Backend Engineering

  
  

Primary Stack: Python, Django/FastAPI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, PostgreSQL, Redis, Go, Angular/TypeScript, Docker

  
  

**ROLE SUMMARY**

  
  

Build practical, production-oriented AI applications and agentic workflows for Nextpower's engineering and business platforms.

  
  

You will develop agents that can understand tasks, use tools and APIs, work with enterprise data, produce structured outputs, and involve people when approval or review is required. You will integrate these capabilities into our Python/Django, Go, and Angular/TypeScript platform on Azure.

  
  

The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals and a willingness to balance rapid experimentation with reliability, security, evaluation, and maintainability.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
  

* Design and build agentic AI features using tool/function calling, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Integrate agents with APIs, databases, documents, business services, and external systems.
* Select appropriate solutions, including deterministic workflows, single-agent solutions, or multi-agent orchestration.
* Build LLM applications using prompt engineering, context management, RAG, vector search, and model APIs.
* Implement asynchronous workflows with retries, timeouts, progress tracking, and recovery.
* Integrate AI capabilities into backend services and expose them through clean APIs and user interfaces.
* Define evaluations and automated tests for accuracy, task completion, tool use, reliability, latency, cost, and safety.
* Add guardrails for prompt injection, unauthorized actions, data leakage, and unsafe tool use.
* Add tracing and observability for prompts, model calls, retrieval, tool calls, workflow state, errors, latency, and cost.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, QA, security, and subject-matter experts to deliver maintainable AI capabilities.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

  
  

* Professional software engineering experience.
* Hands-on experience building an LLM-powered or agentic AI application, prototype, or production feature.
* Strong Python skills with Django, FastAPI, or a similar backend framework.
* Practical understanding of LLM application patterns, including tool calling, structured outputs, prompt and context management, agent workflows, and RAG.
* Experience with an LLM or agent framework such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar.
* Experience integrating APIs, databases, or business services into AI workflows.
* Understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, retries, and error handling.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, Redis, and Docker.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, testing, observability, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong fundamentals in software design, debugging, version control, code reviews, and maintainability.

  

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

  
  

* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or Azure AI Search.
* Experience deploying AI applications to the cloud.
* Experience with multi-step, asynchronous, or long-running agent workflows.
* Experience with PostgreSQL/pgvector or another vector database.
* Go backend or Angular/TypeScript experience.
* Familiarity with event-driven systems, queues, workflow orchestration, or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience with AI-assisted development or developer-productivity tools.

  

**SOFT SKILLS**

  
  

* Curious, pragmatic, and able to learn rapidly in a changing technology area.
* Strong quality, security, and reliability mindset.
* Able to choose when agentic AI is appropriate and when deterministic logic is preferable.
* Clear communicator with strong ownership of outcomes.
* Comfortable working through ambiguity and iterating from prototype to production.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

  
  
  
  
**We are Nextpower**

**Why choose us?**

  
  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

title: Vehicle Systems Integration Specialist
description:
Company Description  

**Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

  
  
Job Description  

**Roles & Responsibilities :**

  

* Design 3D models and assemblies in commonly used CAD platforms.
* Ensure bracket designs and fastening methods withstand automotive vibration, thermal cycling, and harsh operating environments.
* Generate production-ready 2D design drawings with the relevant dimensions and tolerances.
* Analyze packaging constraints, clearance limits, and access/ergonomic requirements within various vehicle compartments (e.g., engine bay, cabin, under body, boot space).
* Apply clear understanding of DFMA and process capabilities (e.g., stamping, bending, CNC machining, laser cutting) to design cost-effective, easy-to-manufacture components.
* Design, prototype, and release sheet metal, machined, and additive manufactured (3D-printed/rapid prototype) brackets to safely mount sensors and hardware in restricted spaces while adhering to automotive durability and dynamic loads.
* Translate physical and technical integration requirements for automotive sensors (e.g., pressure, temperature, IMUs, speed, position) and data acquisition (DAQ) measurement hardware into mechanical mounting requirements.
* Select and apply appropriate fasteners (e.g., rivets, weld nuts, clinching/PEM fasteners, bolts, and clips) and joint techniques suited for specific automotive sheet metal and machined joints.
* Understand electrical schematics, translate them into harness preparation instructions.
* Coordinate with local vendors for rapid prototyping (3D printing, sheet metal, machining and plastic parts).
* Guide technicians integrating components on the car with work instructions and ensure adherence to best practices.

  
Qualifications  

**Educational qualification:**

  

* B.E. / B. Tech. in Mechanical Engg./Automotive Engg.

**Experience :**

  

* 5 - 7 years

**Mandatory/required Skills :**

  

* Strong foundation in Mechanical Engineering and its application to product design.
* Knowledge of failure mechanisms and mitigation measures for mechanical components of various metallic and non-metallic (polymer) materials.
* Expertise in usage of one or more CAD tools (NX, Creo/ProE, CATIA, or SolidWorks)
* Hands-on experience in mechanical integration of components on vehicles and coordination with other teams for electrical integration on vehicles.
* Mechanical design and development of sheet metal parts, machined components, and custom mounting solutions tailored for automotive components.
* Make flat pattern/unfolded views for sheet metal fabrication.
* Ability to identify and apply dimensions and tolerances from international design standards to standard automotive components such as fastener joints, hydraulic joints and shaft-hole systems.
* Apply standard cable management and routing concepts for automotive wire harnesses - enforce minimum bend radii, incorporate strain relief, separation from heat sources, sharp sheet metal edges, and moving components.

**Preferred Skills :**

  

* Ability to identify basic automotive electrical connections (power and signals) in the car and how to safely tap into the stock car electrical networks.
* Identify harness routings, verify pinouts and connector interfaces, and conduct electrical continuity checks to ensure proper system wiring during setup and integration testing.

Passionate about solving complex business problems through innovation, with a pragmatic approach to balancing speed, quality, security, and operational

Prior experience in payment fraud detection modeling

PhD/Master’s in CS, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related STEM field

title: Lead Gen AI Engineer - Vice President
description:
Discover your future at Citi  

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

  
  
Job Overview  
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Generative AI Developer to help drive the design, development, and integration of state-of-the-art Generative AI and **agentic AI** solutions across our enterprise Controls Technology platform. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute deep technical expertise in context engineering, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration, and play a key role in delivering scalable, grounded AI solutions to enhance automation and operational efficiency. This role centers on architecting robust applications and agent systems on top of pre-trained and hosted foundation models — not on training or fine-tuning models.

  
Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with AI architects, leads, and stakeholders to design and implement generative and agentic AI solutions that address business challenges.
* Architect advanced **context engineering** strategies — context layering, chaining, compression, pruning/offloading, and memory management — to maximize reliability, provenance, and token efficiency in production.
* Design and implement advanced generative AI methods, including sophisticated **prompt engineering** and **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**.
* Build and optimize **RAG systems**, including hybrid search, multi-vector retrieval, and re-ranking pipelines.
* Design and implement **knowledge graphs** and **Graph RAG** architectures to enable multi-hop reasoning, explainability, and traceable, grounded responses for high-value business domains.
* Architect **agentic workflows and multi-agent systems** using **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)** and comparable frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, CrewAI), applying orchestration patterns such as supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and peer-to-peer.
* Design robust **agent harnesses** — governance, constraints, feedback loops, state/session management, and execution controls that make long-running agent systems reliable and safe.
* Integrate agents with tools and data via the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** and orchestrate inter-agent collaboration and task delegation via the **Agent2Agent (A2A)** protocol.
* Support the integration of GenAI and agentic applications into production environments, ensuring robust deployment, scalability, observability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the development and optimization of real-time and streaming AI solutions.
* Stay current with the latest advances in generative and agentic AI and actively share knowledge with the team.
* Ensure adherence to ethical AI guidelines, guardrails, agent isolation/sandboxing, data privacy, and compliance standards.
* Mentor junior team members, provide code reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence.

Required Technical Skills

* Deep, hands-on expertise in **core generative AI concepts** — foundation models, LLMs, embeddings, tokenization, and context-window management.
* Advanced skills in **prompt engineering** and **context engineering**, including familiarity with prompt design tools/frameworks and dynamic context orchestration.
* Strong experience building **RAG systems**, including chunking strategies, hybrid search, and multi-vector retrieval.
* Practical experience designing **knowledge graphs** and **Graph RAG** pipelines (e.g., using graph databases such as Neo4j or ArangoDB) for relationship-aware, multi-hop retrieval.
* Proven experience building **agentic AI systems** with **Google ADK** and/or comparable frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK), including tool/function calling, planning, and memory.
* Strong grasp of **multi-agent orchestration** patterns (supervisor/worker, hierarchical, peer-to-peer) and **harness engineering** (governance, feedback loops, execution controls, agent isolation/sandboxing).
* Hands-on experience with **agent interoperability protocols** — the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** for tool/data access and the **Agent2Agent (A2A)** protocol for inter-agent collaboration.
* Experience with **agent observability and evaluation** (e.g., tracing, OpenTelemetry-based tooling) for production agent systems.
* Proficiency with **major GenAI APIs** (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.) and orchestration frameworks such as **LangChain and LlamaIndex**.
* Strong skills in **NLP** (NER, dependency parsing, text classification, topic modeling).
* Proficiency with **vector databases** and embedding models for large-scale retrieval.
* Experience with containerization (**Docker**), orchestration (**Kubernetes**), and CI/CD pipelines for AI/agentic applications.
* Solid understanding of AI compliance, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong skills in **Python** and experience with data preprocessing, document ingestion, and API development.

Required Soft Skills

* Strong collaboration skills to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Analytical and proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Clear communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Eagerness to learn, innovate, and mentor less experienced developers.

Qualifications

* 5–7 years of experience in AI/software development, including significant experience in Generative AI and agentic AI.
* Demonstrated portfolio of successful AI-driven projects in a business environment.

**Job Details:**  
  
Job Description: The Role and Impact:

Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms.

  
  

Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use.

  
  

In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters.

  
  

This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it.

  
  

Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software.

  
  

If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection.

  
  
About the Team:

The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms.

  
  

We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams.

  
  

Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy.

  
  

The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems.

  
  
Key Responsibilities:  

·   Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack.

  
  

·   Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture.

  
  

·   Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes.

  
  

·   Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization.

  
  

·   Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies.

  
  

·   Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling.

  
  

·   Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware.

  
  

·   Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance.

  
  

·   Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements.

  
  

Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams.

·   BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  
  

·   Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms.

  
  

·   Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements.

  
  

·   Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust.

  
  

·   Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior.

  
  

·   Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools.

  
  
Preferred Qualifications:  

·   Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8.

  
  

·   Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent.

  
  

·   Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms.

  
  

·   Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling.

  
  

·   Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions.

  
  

·   Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**The opportunity**

  
  

ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.

  
  

You will be the first data scientist in our India team. At first, you will meet specialist teams, identify valuable use cases and build focused proofs of concept that demonstrate what data science and AI can do. As these relationships mature, you will help develop our ability to deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with the wider data science team from discovery through implementation. Knowledge of energy would help, initiative, technical breadth and the ability to earn trust across disciplines are central to the role.

  
  

**What you will do**

  
  

•Meet colleagues across practice areas to understand their work, identify specific use cases and agree what a useful result would look like.

  

•Initially, scope and demonstrate focused proofs of concept, choosing suitable methods from statistical analysis and forecasting to machine learning and language models.

  

•Explain methods, limitations and potential value clearly to specialists and nontechnical colleagues. Use their feedback to improve the solution and build confidence in the team’s services.

  

•Assess data quality, feasibility, privacy and delivery needs, and define the evidence needed to take a prototype further.

  

•As demand grows, design and deliver data science and AI solutions across projects with the wider team, from modelling and evaluation to integration, documentation and adoption. Contribute to proposals and client presentations.

  

•Establish reusable ways of working and help turn early demonstrations into a sustainable pipeline of well-defined client work.

  
  

**What you will bring**

  
  

•Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.

  

•Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.

  

•Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.

  

•Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.

  

•Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.

  

•Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.

  

•A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.

  
  

**Useful additional experience**

  
  

•Experience in energy, utilities, climate or environmental policy, particularly applied analysis with domain experts.

  

•Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.

  

•Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.

  
  

**How we work**

  

As the first data scientist in our India team, you will have the opportunity to shape how our established data science and AI services grow there. You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges, and see promising ideas develop into project work. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.

  
  

**Bot and Third-Party Applications**

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.**Candidate AI Usage Policy**

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. **Job Details**   
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

Cencora is a leading global pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare solutions organization dedicated to improving the lives of people and animals worldwide. Through its extensive network of manufacturers, healthcare providers, pharmacies, and patients, Cencora helps ensure timely and reliable access to critical therapies and healthcare services. The company continually invests in innovative technologies, operational excellence, and talented professionals to advance healthcare delivery and create meaningful impact across the global healthcare ecosystem.

  
  

**Summary:**

  

The Senior Platform Engineer for Leena AI is a senior individual contributor within the Platform Engineering organization, responsible for owning and operating Cencora's Leena AI deployment — an agentic AI platform used to automate HR, IT, and employee support workflows at enterprise scale. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role applies deep technical expertise to extend Leena AI's capabilities by connecting it to internal systems via custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, alongside platform configuration, integration engineering, and operational monitoring responsibilities.

  
  
Platform Administration

* Configure and maintain the Leena AI instance, including Knowledge Studio content sources, permissions and access controls, and governance policies.
* Build and optimize agentic workflows using AOP Studio and Workflow Studio, translating HR and IT business requirements into automated AI Colleague processes.
* Own the Leena AI platform roadmap, proactively identifying opportunities to expand automation coverage and enhance employee experience.

MCP & Integration Engineering (Core Focus)

* Design, implement, and maintain Custom MCP Connectors to register internal MCP servers with Leena AI, enabling internal tools and data sources to be surfaced as agent actions.
* Configure and manage authentication methods for MCP servers, including: No Authentication (internal/public endpoints) Custom Header/API Key Authentication Admin OAuth 2.0 User OAuth 2.0
* Perform OAuth client registration, redirect URI setup, and credential management where required.
* Validate and troubleshoot tool discovery and runtime schema synchronization across connected MCP servers as services evolve.
* Assess and implement pre-built MCP connectors and the Pipedream MCP Connector where appropriate, making informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Coordinate network connectivity, infrastructure requirements, and security reviews for internally hosted MCP servers in partnership with enterprise infrastructure and security teams.

Enterprise Integrations

* Maintain and enhance integrations with core enterprise platforms, including: Workday ServiceNow Microsoft 365 SharePoint
* Utilize Leena AI native connectors and REST API connectors when MCP-based integration is not suitable.
* Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for enterprise integrations and provide guidance on optimal approaches for new connectivity requirements.

Monitoring, Quality & Reporting

* Monitor chatbot conversations, agent performance, and automation accuracy; investigate negative use cases and continuously improve training data and FAQs.
* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including: Ticket Deflection Rate Resolution Time Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Review execution logs, platform alerts, and credential-expiration notifications across all connected systems and proactively resolve issues.
* Prepare and present regular platform health, adoption, utilization, and performance reports to leadership and key stakeholders.

Security & Governance

* Administer role-based access controls (RBAC), audit trails, and connector security across the platform.
* Manage OAuth credentials, API keys, secrets, and certificate rotation processes for all integrations, including custom MCP connections.
* Ensure platform operations comply with organizational information security policies, regulatory requirements, and data governance standards.

Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) is home to the world’s most iconic entertainment, news, and sports brands — HBO Max, CNN, Discovery+, DC, Warner Bros., Bleacher Report, Food Network, and many more. Within the Data & Audience Platform (DAP) organization, our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad builds the foundational AI/ML intelligence that powers identity, audience, advertising, and personalization across every WBD brand. We turn first-party signals from hundreds of millions of viewers into production ML systems that expand addressable audiences, sharpen targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — directly driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, engagement, and retention.

At WBD, MLEs do rigorous data science *and* own the engineering that brings models to life: production ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and the ML infrastructure — feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps — that makes our work reliable, repeatable, and scalable. We build primarily on **Databricks**, with strong working knowledge of **Snowflake** and **AWS**, and we are an early, enthusiastic adopter of agentic AI development workflows.

**About the Role**

As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across WBD’s global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**ML System Design & Ownership**

* Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models.
* Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the WBD feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs.
* Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM).

**Modeling & Experimentation**

* Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching.
* Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case.
* Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs.
* Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR).

**MLOps & Infrastructure**

* Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks.
* Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency.
* Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds.
* Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design.

**Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs.
* Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Flagship Projects You’ll Work On**

* **Identity Intelligence** — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all WBD brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching.
* **Audience Intelligence** — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms.
* **ML-based Forecasting** — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions.
* **Content Preferences & Affinity** — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion.

**Required**

* 5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.).
* Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records).
* Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery.
* Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda).
* Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization.

**Reference Architecture & Design Authority**

  

* Define and maintain the programme's reference architecture, covering document intake, OCR and extraction, retrieval, speech, identity verification, agents, the AI gateway, evaluation and guardrails

**Model & Hosting Strategy**

  

* Set open-weight and Indian sovereign models hosted on IndiaAI GPU compute as the default, and define when approved third-party model APIs may be used

* Design integration with Digital India platforms, government identity and single sign-on services, e-office and payment systems, and departmental databases

* **SIEM Engineering:** Manage our SIEM platform, onboard and normalize log sources, build and maintain parsers, and ensure high-fidelity data pipelines for detection and investigation. Focus on improving log coverage, data quality, and platform performance.

* **SOAR & Automation:** Create and maintain automated workflows and playbooks using SOAR platforms to optimize alert triage, enrichment, and response. Identify and automate manual processes within security operations to enhance scalability.
* **AI-Augmented Security Operations:** Investigate and implement AI and machine learning to boost security operations, including alert triage, incident response, threat intelligence analysis, and detection content enrichment. Assess emerging AI tools for responsible integration into workflows.
* **Threat Intelligence Integration:** Utilize threat intelligence from various sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, SOAR playbooks, and hunting activities. Ensure actionable intelligence is timely and structured.
* **Threat Hunting:** Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts to uncover attacker activity that bypasses existing detections. Document findings to inform and enhance detection engineering and tools.
* **Incident Response Support:** Provide engineering support during security incidents, aiding in investigation, containment, and recovery. Contribute to post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improved detections and playbooks.

  

**What you’ll bring to the role:**  
We seek a technically proficient security professional with hands-on experience in security capabilities within complex environments. The ideal candidate will have:

* **Technical Security Experience:** Extensive experience in security engineering, DevSecOps, or a similar role, particularly in securing cloud-native environments and modern application stacks.
* **Detection & Response Skills:** Practical experience in developing and tuning SIEM detections, writing threat hunting queries, and engaging in incident response.
* **SecOps Tooling:** Proficiency in administering and operating core security tools like SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR/XDR solutions, and vulnerability scanners, with experience integrating these tools for detection and response workflows.
* **Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting:** Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and feeds (e.g., MISP, Recorded Future, VirusTotal), and the ability to integrate intelligence into security tooling and detection logic. Knowledge of threat hunting methodologies is highly desirable.
* **Scripting & Automation:** Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) for building security tools and automating workflows.
* **Application Security Knowledge:** Understanding of secure development practices, OWASP top risks, and experience in code reviews or collaboration with developers to address security findings.
* **Security Frameworks & Standards:** Knowledge of relevant security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK) and compliance standards like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Strong ability to communicate technical security risks and recommendations to diverse stakeholders and work cross-functionally to achieve security objectives.
* **Incident Response & Digital Forensics:** Experience leading or supporting security incident investigations, including evidence preservation, log analysis, timeline reconstruction, and root cause identification. Familiarity with forensic tools and methodologies is highly valued.
